title: Ban account
reasonLabel: Reason (required, shown to the banned user)
reasonHint: At most 4,096 characters. A ban revokes every sign-in session. Timed bans are not supported yet: a ban lasts until it is lifted.
reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than 4,096 characters.

banDialog.title: Ban {username}?
banDialog.body: The account is locked, every sign-in session is revoked and the account is hidden from the leaderboard.

banned.title: This account is banned
banned.unbanHint: Unbanning restores the rank "user", shows the account again and activates it.

unbanDialog.title: Unban {username}?
unbanDialog.body: The account gets the rank "user" back, shows on the leaderboard again and can sign in again.
